C:P1.1.text: LICT Corporation | Rural Telecommunications Holding Company

C:P1.2.text: LICT Corporation is a rural telecommunications holding company operating multiple subsidiaries across eight states, providing broadband, voice, and data services to rural markets.

C:P1.3.text: LICT Corporation is a diversified broadband and communications company that serves customers with fiber, wireless and next-generation solutions bringing advanced connectivity services to rural areas and adjacent urban markets.

C:P1.5.text: LICT Corporation is a holding company with subsidiaries providing integrated broadband, voice and video services to business and residential customers in rural markets across the United States. The company, with operations in Utah, New Mexico, Kansas, Wisconsin, Iowa, California and Oregon, provides services through its existing and expanding network infrastructure, including thousands of miles of fiber, copper, coaxial cable, wireless towers and owned wireless spectrum. The company also provides fixed wireless services through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Sound Broadband.

C:P1.6.text: Broadband through advanced fiber networks, Digital Subscriber Line (DSL) and cable modem services

C:P1.8.text: Voice, local and long-distance. Video, including cable television services (CATV) and Internet Protocol Television Services (ITV)

C:P1.9.text: Wholesale network access for other carriers

C:P1.10.text: Enterprise solutions, including hosted/managed services, private lines and virtual switchboard

C:P1.11.text: Public access services, including 911 emergency service

C:P1.13.text: Interim Chairman & CEO · Mario J. Gabelli

C:P1.15.text: Additional Fiber Construction Projects Secured By Cal-Ore

C:P2.2.text: LICT Corporation is a Delaware-incorporated holding company focused on rural broadband and telecommunications. Learn about our operating strategy, subsidiaries, and investment thesis.

C:P2.3.text: Rural Telecommunications Infrastructure Across Eight States

C:P2.4.text: LICT Corporation is a holding company that acquires and operates regulated telecommunications subsidiaries serving rural markets. The company provides broadband, voice and video services through multiple operating subsidiaries — functioning as the primary carrier in each service territory.

C:P2.5.text: LICT's growth strategy is based on three pillars that drive value creation: network and service expansion, government programs and mergers and acquisitions.

C:P2.6.text: Network Expansion Through Broadband Deployment & Subscriber Growth

C:P2.7.text: Broadband services remain the primary growth driver of LICT's telecommunications operations. We are mid-cycle in our growth strategy and focused on a network construction expansion program. Key metrics of our continuing success include:

C:P2.9.text: Expanding copper cable and coaxial miles

C:P2.11.text: Boosting total voice lines, video subscribers, hosted voice seats and spectrum licenses

C:P2.12.text: LICT benefits from federal and state programs that support the expansion of high-speed broadband infrastructure in rural markets. Independently, each LICT subsidiary maintains stand-alone regulatory relationships and an ETC designation within their respective state jurisdiction. Regulated revenue programs include:

C:P2.13.text: LICT has completed 38 acquisitions most recently Manti Telephone Company and its partner companies.
